title: Zero-step route audit does not earn an emptiness premise
situation: A typed R EMPTY claim names an ordered SOS certificate but has no current verifier verdict. A zero-step inference has an empty route, so its audit returns success without inspecting proof replay. The same exact SOS identity can separately be replayed as a positive receipt control.

inputs.attempted_authority: EMPTY premise from zero-step audit alone

attempted_conclusion: Promote a true zero-step route audit to earned EMPTY premise authority without a current checked receipt.

expected.reason: An empty transport path has no failed step but supplies no verifier-earned certificate reach.

sources.anchor: All zero-step audits return (True, []) independently of proof replay.
